exposure: duration (hours) from EP diagnosis to second bhCG test
outcome: success of expectant management for ectopic pregnancy
cohort: Stable patients with ampullar ectopic pregnancy treated with expectant management between 2014 and 2022.
finding: A Decision Tree-Based classifier model demonstrated high precision (92%) and recall (95%) in predicting the success of expectant management for hemodynamically stable patients with ectopic pregnancy, particularly within the initial 24 hours of bhCG follow-up.
gest_age: Gestational age at decision day (of ectopic pregnancy) was used as a predictor.
